Whether you are a professional or just a keen amateur, Find Stone will help you identify different types of minerals and gemstones with ease and accuracy just from a photo. 

The main features of the app are: 

1. Photo Recognition: Just take a picture of a mineral or gemstone and our app will instantly identify its name and provide you with detailed information about its characteristics, origin and use.

2. Large database: We provide access to a huge database containing thousands of minerals and gemstones from all over the world. You can easily find information about any specimen you are interested in. We are constantly updating our database to provide you with the most up-to-date information about new finds and discoveries in the world of geology.

3.Creating Collections : We also offer additional features such as creating a collection of your favorite minerals, adding your own notes and markings.

4.Stone matching by zodiac sign : We have a section in which you can find out which stones are suitable for your zodiac sign and what influence they may have on you. 

5. Fake & Real : Fascinating articles that will help you determine whether a stone or mineral is precious or not.

Don't miss the opportunity to dive into the amazing world of minerals and gems with Find Stone. Download the app now and become an expert in recognizing and studying various minerals and gemstones!
